title: UPS (2N) — sequence of operations
note: PRD-SETPOINT-SIM P3. Curated. A threshold is never typed here: a condition names a limit of the conv limits registry (limit), an engine parameter (param) or a value the engine derives (derived); tools/build-sequences.mjs resolves it. A delay that no source states is ASSUMED and says why.

basis.ref: IEC 62040-3:2021 (UPS performance: double conversion, stored-energy and bypass modes) and the Uptime Institute Tier IV / 2N topology
basis.use: the structure: normal double conversion, stored-energy (battery) mode on an input failure, static bypass on an inverter fault or overload, maintenance bypass, and the 2N transfer of the IT load to the other system
basis.limits: the numbers come from this plant's engine (systems, modules, module rating, IT load) and its limits registry, not from the standards

fleet.noun: UPS systems in one hall (streams A and B)

plant: 2N per hall: stream A and stream B UPS, each a parallel group of modules; a system's share in one hall = the engine's system rating over the halls (js/conv-engine.js electrical: ups_system_rated_kw = ups_modules_per_system × ups_module_kw_rated, one system spans the four halls; EPMS E-S-102 draws 8 × 1,250 kW per hall and stream). Dual-corded IT load shared between the two; either stream alone carries the hall's IT load

modes.label: Normal — double conversion, load shared

entry.text: input healthy, every module on its inverter, both systems sharing the dual-corded IT load

actions: rectifiers feed the DC bus and float-charge the batteries; inverters supply the critical bus
each system carries half the IT load

exit.event: rectifier input voltage or frequency out of tolerance

exit.text: system load above its normal-mode high warning

exit.event: a whole UPS system or its output breaker is lost

modes.label: Stored energy — on battery

entry.event: rectifier input lost (utility failure before the generators carry the bus)

actions: the inverters keep the critical bus from the batteries with no break
alarm; the generating sets start on the same utility failure (generating-set sequence)

exit.event: rectifier input restored (generators or utility) and the rectifiers walk the load back in

modes.notModelled: battery autonomy and the state of charge after the outage are not modelled in this plant

modes.label: Module fault — the others share
actions: the faulted module isolates itself from the parallel bus; alarm
the remaining modules of that system share its load

exit.event: the module is repaired and back on the bus

modes.label: High load — alarm
actions: alarm to the operator: in 2N a system above half its rating could not carry the other's load alone
hold new IT load until it is resolved

modes.label: Static bypass

entry.event: inverter fault or an overload beyond the inverter's rating

actions: the static switch transfers the critical bus to the bypass supply with no break
the load is unprotected from input disturbances while on bypass; alarm

exit.event: the inverter is healthy and the load within its rating: retransfer to the inverter

modes.label: System lost — the other carries the IT load

entry.event: a whole UPS system or its output breaker is lost

actions: dual-corded IT equipment draws all of its load from the other system's PDUs
the remaining system runs at the engine's failover load; alarm

exit.event: the system is restored and shares the load again

modes.notModelled: single-corded IT equipment behind a static transfer switch is not modelled
